{
  "draft": "Hypothesis: input mutation. Contradiction: evaluator flags x modified. Fix: ensure x is read-only. Verify: x[0,0] unchanged. Output y[r,c] = w[c] * (x[r,c] * rsqrt(mean(x[r,:]^2)+eps)). Cast normalized to x.dtype before w multiply.",
  "plan": "Allocate fresh contiguous out. Read x via pointer, never write. Mask cols < width. Sum x^2 in FP32, divide by width. Cast normalized to BF16/FP32. Multiply by w. Store to out. Grid = rows. No input writes.",
  "code_lines": [
    "import torch",
    "import triton",
    "import triton.language as tl",
    "",
    "",
    "@triton.jit",
    "def _rmsnorm_kernel(",
    "    X,",
    "    W,",
    "    Y,",
    "    stride_x,",
    "    stride_y,",
    "    width,",
    "    eps,",
    "    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,",
    "    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,",
    "):",
    "    row = tl.program_id(0)",
    "    x_ptr = X + row * stride_x",
    "    y_ptr = Y + row * stride_y",
    "    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)",
    "    mask = cols < width",
    "    x = tl.load(x_ptr + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)",
    "    x2 = x * x",
    "    sum_x2 = tl.sum(x2, axis=0)",
    "    mean_x2 = sum_x2 / width",
    "    rstd = tl.rsqrt(mean_x2 + eps)",
    "    normalized = x * rstd",
    "    if IS_BF16:",
    "        normalized = normalized.to(tl.bfloat16)",
    "    else:",
    "        normalized = normalized.to(tl.float32)",
    "    w = tl.load(W + cols, mask=mask, other=0.0)",
    "    y = w * normalized",
    "    tl.store(y_ptr + cols, y, mask=mask)",
    "",
    "",
    "def run(x, weight):",
    "    rows, width = x.shape",
    "    out = torch.empty_like(x)",
    "    BLOCK = triton.next_power_of_2(width)",
    "    is_bf16 = x.dtype == torch.bfloat16",
    "    grid = (rows,)",
    "    _rmsnorm_kernel[grid](",
    "        x,",
    "        weight,",
    "        out,",
    "        width,",
    "        width,",
    "        width,",
    "        1e-6,",
    "        BLOCK=BLOCK,",
    "        IS_BF16=is_bf16,",
    "    )",
    "    return out"
  ]
}
